title: cDNA Synthesis
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgnbjvan
materials: Scope and Applicability: Covers the synthesis of first-strand cDNA from total RNA using the Invitrogen SuperScript III Reverse Transcriptase system.
Invitrogen Superscript III First-Strand Synthesis System (Invitrogen 18080-051) at
Rainin Single Pipette: p10, p20, p200
MB0050 PCR Prep from cDNA for IVT Reactions
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Pull out Invitrogen SuperScript III First-Strand Synthesis kit from -20ºC:
Once thawed, vortex and spin down all reagents except flick to mix RNase OUT, SuperScript III RT and RNA aliquot. Spin down all reagents.
Determine that all duplicate samples show alike traces.
Reassemble Invitrogen SuperScript III First-Strand Synthesis System by replacing all tubes that were removed from the box.

steps.title: Thaw reagents at room temperature
steps.instruction: Thaw the following reagents at room temperature (RT): anchored dT, 10 mM dNTP mix, NF‑H₂O, 10× RT Buffer, 25 mM MgCl₂, 0.1 M DTT (15 min) and RNase OUT and SuperScript III RT (place on benchtop cooler). Also thaw each RNA aliquot at RT for 10 min.

steps.title: Label plates and tubes
steps.instruction: Label a PCR plate with the cDNA plate name (format cDNA_YYMMDD_PP). Label one 1.7 mL tube “cDNA Syn Premix”. Label additional 1.7 mL tubes “01”, “02”, “03”, … for each RNA+Primer premix as required by the worksheet.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑Primer premix
steps.instruction: Using the cDNA worksheet table, calculate volumes (including waste) and make the RNA+Primer premix in each labeled 1.7 mL tube. Add components in this order: nuclease‑free water, anchored dT, then total RNA.

steps.title: Dispense premix into PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using a p200 repeater pipette with filter tips, aliquot each RNA+Primer premix into the corresponding wells of the labeled PCR plate according to the plate map.

steps.title: Anneal primers at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat the thermal cycler to 65 °C and select a program for 65 °C for 10 min. Place the PCR plate in the thermal cycler, spin down (microcentrifuge 5–10 s at top speed or benchtop centrifuge 2 min at 1800 rpm) and incubate for 5 min at 65 °C. After incubation, immediately move the plate to a benchtop cooler for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA synthesis premix
steps.instruction: While the RNA+Primer plate is incubating, spin down each cDNA synthesis reagent, then follow the worksheet table to assemble the cDNA Synthesis Premix (volumes include waste) by adding reagents in the order listed.

steps.title: Add cDNA synthesis premix to plate
steps.instruction: Using a 12‑channel p20 pipette with filter tips (change tips between rows), add 10 µL of the cDNA Synthesis Premix to each well containing the RNA+Primer premix.

steps.title: Mix and spin down
steps.instruction: Mix each well by pipetting up and down 3–4 times, then spin down (microcentrifuge 5–10 s at top speed or benchtop centrifuge 2 min at 1800 rpm).

steps.title: Run cDNA synthesis thermal program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the thermal cycler and run the preset program “cDNA‑dT” (reaction conditions as defined by the instrument program).

steps.title: Post‑reaction spin down
steps.instruction: After the program finishes, remove the plate and spin down (microcentrifuge 5–10 s at top speed or benchtop centrifuge 2 min at 1800 rpm).

steps.title: Analyze cDNA on Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Run the samples on the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using the mRNA Nano program. Refer to MB0004 2100 Bioanalyzer Operation for PCR, GTP, and IVT Products.

steps.title: Pool duplicate samples
steps.instruction: If duplicate wells give matching Bioanalyzer profiles, pool each duplicate pair into a new 1.7 mL tube (different tube for each original premix). Label tubes as cDNA_YYMMDD_PP_WW‑WW where WW‑WW denotes the well range.

steps.title: Store cDNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the labeled tubes in a box marked “cDNA” and store at –20 °C.
